items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So Diz organized this group, and he had Al Haig and Stan Levy

ctx.x: How come they let Stan Levy in?

Well, Stan Levy was a real good brush man, but he didn't make the records. He was with the band, but he didn't record it. Big Sid Catlett recorded it. Now, this is something else that people aren't aware of. When you get a big band drummer, it's hard for him to tone himself down to combo level, you know, and vice versa. A combo man, it's hard for him to step into a big band and play forcefully and be heard. You know, because he's been playing at a certain level, a certain volume. But Big Sid toned himself down.…
out here. He had to Camarillo for a time. And what was the tune that they recorded?
